hseq.value: NQA-certified Integrated Management System — ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environmental), ISO 45001:2018 (health & safety). Primary goal: construction-industry-leading OH&S performance and wellbeing — an injury-free workplace. The three standards share one high-level structure carried by one set of manuals and procedures; all require document and records control, internal audits, and corrective and preventive actions. Eleven stated intended outcomes (knowledge base, satisfaction and pride, continual improvement, supportive culture, worker consultation, resourcing, aligned policies, hazard/risk/opportunity processes, audit-based monitoring, business-process integration, minimised environmental and community impacts).
